description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key field information contained in a food production license, such as the operator name, unified social credit code, legal representative name, address, business premises, business scope, validity period, and license number
description_zh: 可快速精准的识别食品生产许可证所包含经营者名称、社会信用代码、法定代表人姓名、地址、经营场所、经营项目、有效期、许可证编号等关键字段信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-food-produce-license --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1YaMhXKT2gK0jSZFvXXXnFXXa-1414-1000.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeFoodProduceLicense

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one of them; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported).
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one of them; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.  
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.  
When invoking via HTTP, upload the binary file of the image in the HTTP body.  
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body.
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body
